name: OmaIMAPMail
author: Ed Downes (eddownes)
description: Multi-account IMAP unread mail in one bar icon — per-account colors, filtering, desktop notifications, and an in-shell settings form to add/edit/remove accounts. Fork of keithnyc/omafmail.

barWidget.description: Combined unread count across every configured IMAP account, with a sender/subject/preview popup, per-account filtering, and a settings form to add accounts
